name: nGZSceneGraph::cIndexedMeshBuilder::MergeGroups
notes: Finish step 4 (lane QL): with more than one group, groups of equal flags (unsigned order, stable) merge into one (vertices appended, triangles shifted by the earlier count); the runs follow (start/end shifted, group renumbered). Called only by Finish. Mutants killed by the builder tests: the sort descending, the runs not renumbered, the groups moved instead of copy-assigned (an emptied list keeps its buffer in the game). NOT covered: the merge itself. Groups of equal flags cannot arise from legal data: CommitGroup already joins equal masks, and Finish over kept groups (Reset(true) over a mesh) throws in the original, so the tests never run it; every mutant of the merge branch (triangle offset, shift of the runs, count, normals appended) survives. Hence reimplemented, not verified.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cIndexedMeshBuilder::RebuildRuns

Called only by Finish. Mutants killed by the four builder tests: a run kept when it adds no triangles (>= for >), the run start fixed at 0.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cIndexedMeshBuilder::MergeDuplicateVertices

name: nGZSceneGraph::cIndexedMeshBuilder::ClassifyGroups
notes: Finish step 3 and Read (version below 10) (lane QL): flag bits 7-11 from the influences (weight over 1e-4), morph deltas (squared length over 9.999999e-9, single precision, summed x, y, z) and the extra word lists (groups added since Reset). Indices are trusted; on unfinished or inconsistent data the game reads out of range (crash or heap corruption, QH) and so does this: the tests run it on consistent data only (loose lists, kept meshes and unfinished data are not finished or read on either side).
